title: A Quantum-Enhanced Feedback Oscillator
summary: Feedback oscillators, such as lasers and masers, serve as time references in modern computing, communication, and measurement. Quantum fluctuations ultimately limit their phase stability and ability to keep time precisely; in the absence of quantum engineering, their phase stability is bounded by a standard quantum limit (SQL). Techniques to improve the frequency stability of feedback oscillators beyond the SQL have been theorized, but have not yet been demonstrated. We demonstrate an opto-electronic oscillator (OEO), a type of feedback oscillator, with phase stability approaching the SQL.…
